character-dossier-a.quote: This looks like a job for Superman.
character-dossier-a.style: Direct combat built on strength and speed. He dictates the pace and holds it through the entire fight.
character-dossier-a.advantage: Monstrous statistical advantage in strength, speed, and durability over most opponents.
character-dossier-a.mentality: Usually holds back and fights below his ceiling. When the situation demands it, he goes full power without hesitation.

character-dossier-b.style: Brutal close-quarters aggression. Hyperion massacres enemies with his Atomic Vision and impossible striking power.
character-dossier-b.advantage: Monstrous regeneration and survivability. Hyperion returns to the fight after injuries that would be fatal to others.
character-dossier-b.mentality: Megalo-psychopath with a god complex. He does not hesitate or calculate — he will kill anyone without a second thought if he finds even one reason.

powers: Kryptonian strength, speed, flight, enhanced senses, and combat perception at an elite level.
tools: Heat Vision, Freeze Breath, and full range control combined with aerial mobility.
Solar Flare as a costly but potentially decisive finishing option.
weaknesses: Solar Flare leaves him defenseless if he fails to end the fight immediately.

powers: Extreme strength, flight, massive durability, and near-instantaneous regeneration even after catastrophic injuries.
tools: Atomic Vision as a lethal weapon for piercing resistance and quickly closing out advantages.
Experience killing superheroes and the instinct to exploit their hesitation and limitations.
weaknesses: Extreme arrogance and contempt for opponents cause him to frequently surrender the initiative.

a: Bench-presses a weight equal to Earth's mass for five days.
Reads every published medical text in seconds.
Flies out of a black hole without taking damage.
The only person to survive Doomsday's death aura.
b: Returns to life moments after Namora snaps his neck one hundred and eighty degrees.
Survived the explosion of every nuclear warhead in the world.
Fought two other Hyperions simultaneously and dominated the confrontation.

x-factor.factor: Why don't better stats guarantee victory?
x-factor.implikacja: The less the fight rewards a clean knockout, the more valuable the simple fact that Hyperion keeps coming back becomes.
x-factor.mechanika: Superman has the statistical edge, but Hyperion is one of those opponents where dominance alone is not enough if it does not lead to a permanent end.
x-factor.psychologia: Hyperion can afford to fight more recklessly, because surviving each sequence brings him closer to the moment when his opponent starts to crack.

final-summary.line_1: Superman sets the terms of the fight more cleanly from the opening seconds.
final-summary.line_2: He is faster, more precise, and better at keeping the fight in a safe, controlled form.
final-summary.line_3: The problem is that every unclosed sequence gives Hyperion another chance, and the longer the fight lasts, the more his regeneration starts reversing the entire economy of the matchup.
final-summary.winner: Superman holds the edge. Hyperion still has a real path to victory.

battle-dynamics.label: Standard Rules · Solar Flare
battle-dynamics.phase_1: Superman dictates the pace in every aspect. Speed, distance, and Solar Flare in reserve — optimal conditions for Clark.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Under standard rules Hyperion cannot fully exploit his regeneration. Superman builds his advantage methodically.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Solar Flare closes the fight before Hyperion's regeneration becomes a factor. This is Superman's most repeatable win condition.
battle-dynamics.analysis: Standard rules with Solar Flare is Superman's cleanest victory scenario. Hyperion has no answer for it.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: Early on, Superman dictates the pace through speed, distance, and far cleaner control of exchanges.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: Without Solar Flare, the mid-fight becomes a test of technical precision. Hyperion pushes, but standard rules cap his aggression.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: Without Solar Flare, Superman must be technically flawless. Any breakdown in the clinch gives Hyperion a foothold.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: Without Solar Flare and without death rules, Superman still leads — but the margin is thin and keeps narrowing.
battle-dynamics.s3_label: Fight to the Death · Solar Flare
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_1: Superman opens aggressively — he knows time is his enemy under death rules. Solar Flare is his trump card.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_2: Under death rules Hyperion becomes increasingly dangerous. But Solar Flare stays in Superman's arsenal as an answer to everything.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_3: Solar Flare can definitively end the fight even under death rules. The question is whether Superman can use it before he is too weakened.
battle-dynamics.s3_analysis: Death rules erode Superman's advantages — but Solar Flare is a weapon Hyperion has no answer for.
battle-dynamics.s4_label: Fight to the Death · No Solar Flare
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_1: Early on, Superman dictates the pace through speed, distance, and far cleaner control of exchanges.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_2: If Hyperion survives the first wave of dominance, he starts reclaiming value simply by still standing and returning to fight.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_3: The longer the fight lasts, the less Superman's technical edge matters, and the more Hyperion's brutal regeneration economy takes over.
battle-dynamics.s4_analysis: Superman wins the controlled fight. Hyperion wins the one that goes too long and stops punishing his mistakes.

fight-simulation.label: Standard Rules · Solar Flare
fight-simulation.opening: Superman opens with speed, distance, and far cleaner control of the battlefield.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: If Hyperion survives the first wave, the fight starts pulling away from clean control and becomes an increasingly uncomfortable war of resources.
fight-simulation.late_fight: The endgame comes down to one question: can Superman finish the fight definitively before Hyperion resets the value of each new wave of damage through regeneration.
fight-simulation.end_condition: This fight is not decided by the raw power ceiling — it comes down to whether Superman's advantage gets truly closed before the match turns into attrition.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Hyperion immediately launches a brutal assault, ignoring all rules and constraints. Superman must rely on his speed to counter the momentum.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: The turning point arrives when Hyperion deals the first lasting damage to someone who lacks comparable regeneration.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Superman reclaims distance and wins the technical fight.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Hyperion forces the clinch and grinds Superman down.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Superman either closes the fight with Solar Flare or gets worn down by Hyperion.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Solar Flare closes the fight definitively.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: Hyperion keeps coming back. Every minute works in his favor.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: Hyperion immediately launches a brutal assault, ignoring all rules and constraints. Superman must rely on his speed to counter the momentum.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: Without Solar Flare the fight becomes a more even exchange.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_a: Superman maintains distance and wins the technical fight.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_b: Hyperion forces the clinch and starts landing meaningful exchanges.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Without Solar Flare Superman must win technically for the entire fight without a single mistake.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_a: Superman maintains full control and wins on precision.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: One breakdown in the clinch and Hyperion starts taking over the fight.
fight-simulation.s2_end_condition: Without Solar Flare Superman's win depends entirely on his technical edge — no clean finisher available.
fight-simulation.s3_label: Fight to the Death · Solar Flare
fight-simulation.s3_phase_1_event: Hyperion immediately launches a brutal assault, ignoring all rules and constraints. Superman must rely on his speed to survive the momentum.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_event: Hyperion's regeneration means every exchange works in his favor.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_a: Superman fights technically and waits for the moment to use Solar Flare.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_b: Hyperion keeps the pressure on and gives Superman no room to breathe.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_event: Wounded and cornered, Superman unleashes Solar Flare and kills Hyperion.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_branch_a: Solar Flare destroys Hyperion. Superman wins on the edge of death.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_branch_b: Superman is too exhausted — Solar Flare fails.
fight-simulation.s3_end_condition: Solar Flare is Superman's last card under death rules. All or nothing.
fight-simulation.s4_label: Fight to the Death · No Solar Flare
fight-simulation.s4_phase_1_event: Hyperion immediately launches a brutal assault, ignoring all rules and constraints. Superman must rely on his speed to survive the momentum.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_event: Hyperion endures heavy sequences and regenerates. Every return strengthens his position.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_branch_a: Superman maintains control and keeps Hyperion at distance.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_branch_b: Hyperion gets inside and turns the fight into a war of attrition.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_event: Without Solar Flare Superman has no tool to definitively end the fight.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_branch_a: A technical miracle — Superman pulls out the win on pure precision.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_branch_b: Hyperion dominates. Without Solar Flare there is no answer for him.
fight-simulation.s4_end_condition: Without Solar Flare under death rules — Hyperion simply never stops coming back.

verdict-matrix.case_1: Superman 7/10. Under standard rules and with Solar Flare, he has the cleanest and most repeatable path to victory.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Superman 6/10. Without Solar Flare he still leads if he maintains full control from start to finish and avoids a war of attrition.
verdict-matrix.case_3: Superman 5.5/10. Solar Flare still gives him a real finish route, but a fight to the death rewards Hyperion's survivability more.
verdict-matrix.case_4: King Hyperion 6/10. Without Solar Flare and under death rules, his regeneration starts tilting the fight his way.
